#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll INF = 1000LL * 1000 * 1000;
ll n, rep[18];

ll compute(ll val, int idx);

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    cin >> n;
    rep[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < 18; i++)
        rep[i] = rep[i-1] * 10LL + 1LL;
    cout << compute(n, 17) << endl;
    return 0;
}

ll compute(ll val, int idx) {
    // Inline the computations and use a ternary to combine the min
    ll q = val / rep[idx];
    ll r = val % rep[idx];
    ll base = q * (idx + 1);
    if (r == 0) return base;
    ll option1 = idx + 1 + compute(rep[idx] - r, idx - 1);
    ll option2 = compute(r, idx - 1);
    return base + min(option1, option2);
}
